site_name: St Pauls C Of E Primary School
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until a method statement showing how the slate tiles that would be affected by the development would either be removed, safely stored and replaced with replica slate tiles or how the slate tiles that would be affected by the development would be protected from damage during the installation of the solar panels has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Installation of photovoltaic solar panels to the southern roof of school
